title: Brick Breaker Forge
description: A synthesized-SFX brick breaker with 5 built-in levels, a level editor, five power-ups, and shareable level links.
concept: A real breakout arcade with substance: paddle-and-ball physics with per-brick hit points (1/2/3-hit, indestructible, explosive, and power-up bricks), five hand-built levels of escalating difficulty, and a full level editor where you paint your own layouts, save them to a personal gallery, and share any level as a URL. Power-ups (wide paddle, multi-ball, slow-ball, laser paddle, extra life) fall from broken bricks and change the run in real time.
features: 5 built-in levels plus a full grid-painting level editor (7 tile types incl. explosive & indestructible bricks)
5 power-ups: wide paddle, multi-ball split, slow-ball, laser paddle, extra life
Save custom levels to a personal localStorage gallery, load/delete them
Share any built-in or custom level as a URL (btoa/atob hash) — opening the link auto-imports it
Per-level high scores persisted in localStorage
tech: Per-cell hit-point grid (parallel to the brick-type grid)
Web Audio API synthesized SFX (oscillators + noise-burst explosion)
Pointer Events (mouse + touch drag) & keyboard (arrow keys, space)

interaction.mouse: Drag left/right to move the paddle; click the stage to launch the ball or fire lasers
interaction.click: Tap toolbar buttons to switch Play/Editor mode, pause, restart, save, or share
interaction.touch: Drag anywhere on the stage to move the paddle; tap to launch/fire
interaction.keyboard: Arrow keys move the paddle; space launches the ball or fires the laser
